name: Army Meritorious Unit Commendation
size_citation: Ribbon bar 1 3/8 in x 3/8 in (11:3): DoDM 1348.33 (military decorations, ribbons and devices) and CAPR 39-1 as carried in js/state.js RIBBON_HEIGHT; paragraph numbers to be confirmed against the current publications

laurel.note: leaf pairs at the period measured from the frame, running from the bottom centre up both sides to the top centre

frame.note: thickness measured from the rectified photograph, made equal left and right and top and bottom; one gold for the frame, one pale gold for the laurel, no shading

quality.color_source: clean palette colour per stripe (ribbon-palette.json), the named colour each stripe's measured thread colour belongs to, a unit citation frame is one gold with a pale gold laurel (the owner, 2026-11-18, "a frame is a frame of one gold") settling the close calls; the thread colours of the product photograph (tools/military/ribbon-lit.js) are the earlier measurement and are kept in measurement.restyle.measured_hex, geometry unchanged except as listed in measurement.restyle.repairs
quality.geometry_source: Vanguard product photograph, rectified, mirrored stripes snapped

reference.title: Ribbon Unit Citation: Army Meritorious Unit Commendation

measurement.method: Rectified from the Vanguard product photograph; stripes segmented along the width by a dynamic programme on one thread colour per column; each stripe's colour read from its inner threads (tools/military/ribbon-lit.js), equal colours clustered, mirrored boundaries snapped. Measured by script; the photograph is a measurement reference only and is not shipped
